title_as_printed: Isopiestic ratios for the system water-sodium chloride-calcium chloride at 25 C

footnotes_as_printed.a: Delta = R(calc) - R(obs), where R(calc) is obtained with the aid of eq (1) and the parameters in table 2. (letter a is on the Delta column header)

pressure_note: not applicable (isopiestic equilibrium at 25 C, pressure is the water vapour pressure)

value.what: molality of CaCl2 in the mixed NaCl-CaCl2 solution at isopiestic equilibrium

value2.what: molality of the NaCl reference solution in isopiestic equilibrium (printed once per block, filled down to every row of the block)

composition.other_species: none; mixed solutions contain NaCl and CaCl2. Rows with empty m_B are the pure CaCl2 solution (y_C = 1.0)

extra_unmapped: y_C (ionic fraction of CaCl2, y_C = 1.5 m_C/m, m = m_B + 1.5 m_C; calculated by authors)
R(obs) = M_B/m (isopiestic ratio, calculated by authors)
Delta (R(calc)-R(obs), fit residual, printed in units of 1e-2: Delta x 1e-2 = R(calc) - R(obs), footnote a p.314)
notes: Set and M_B are printed once per block and are filled down to every row (carried-forward values). Sets 1-8 have two M_B blocks each; sets 9 and 10 one. A dotted line in the m_B column (printed dotted) means no NaCl: pure CaCl2 solution, m_B written empty. Pure-CaCl2 rows (y_C = 1.0) are isopiestic CaCl2 versus NaCl reference. The mixed-solution total molality convention: m = m_B + 1.5 m_C. Delta column is written as printed, with sign. Set 2 block 0.8005 and set 8 block 4.5821 have no pure CaCl2 row printed.
